notes.title: On the Road DLC
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27373643/09da16c861742009d2fc76afe590bd7d0633d349.jpg[/img]


Due to Drunk or Dead release anniversary we've conducted a hackathon during which we've made a new kick ass mode for Drunk or Dead. It's name is "On the Road" and now you can drive a car!

You will get:

 - New location - foggy fields
Endless fields of american Corn Belt, covered with fog where you can meet a lot of dangers - lonely abandoned cars, burning barrels and don’t forget about hordes of the ravenous undeads.

 - New gameplay mechanics - death race
Ride through the fear and loathing, crush and shoot enemies, hold as long as possible and remember  that only moving can save you and every stop can cost you a life.

 - New easter eggs for the true genre-fans
A lot of obvious and secret cultural references which will remind you a favorite movies of yours.

Have a good game!

notes.title: Strip Bar update + Uncensored DLC
notes.content:
We've released an update for Drunk or Dead. This time we add a new location, a strip bar with dancing girls, new zombies, a new boss and a new gun.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27373643/dd676f5c4fb3b34636c8d606dfa1947c177b0052.png[/img]

Also, we've updated all existing locations, adding cinematics and features that will introduce the story line.
Now now your actions matter. Players will be able to take choices that will affect how the round ends.

And there is more news.

Due to growing criticism from the society, we decided to remove all content that caused complaints from the game and put it into a separate paid DLC, called Drunk or Dead - Uncensored, to allow users to decide for themselves whether they want to see this content or not.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27373643/028d1089cc352bd23d0a38a1fdad1ab710b04c7a.png[/img]

The content that is moved into the DLC is:

- Red blood
- Ability to chop zombie's head off
- Smoking scenes
- Some types of interaction with NPCs
- Some NPC outfits
- Some Easter Eggs

All users who bought our game before the release of Drunk or Dead: Uncensored will be able to receive this DLC completely for free, and for new users its price will be purely symbolic.

4 I Lab Studio hopes that you will like this update and we hope to continue to please you with our games. 

Our future plans include full support of Teslasuit, a full-body haptic suit. Our goal is to make a more immersive game where players will be able to get more interaction with the world by feeling it.

notes.title: Game optimization update.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27373643/a27d94f85168962a06ed16d38557ee8698fefe54.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone.

Today we release an update that will optimize game performance and will improve gameplay.

Today's update includes:

- Lots of minor bug fixes
- Improved FPS stability
- The gun returns to its place after some time spent on the floor and it is easier pick it up
- Better optimisation for Oculus
- New score counting system

Due to changes to score counting system it is much harder to score in the new version of the game, so we've reset the leaderboard to give players equal chances to be the best.

Have a good game.

notes.title: Summer! It's time to go outside.
notes.content:
We're proud to introduce you an update.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27373643/221c6f070108688d7118b79cb753a00198863757.jpg[/img]

Drunk or Dead, previously known as endless wave shooter, where you must maintain alcohol level in your blood to stay uninfected by zombie virus, will eventually get new locations that player will be able to visit discovering post apocalyptic world.
 
With this friday’s update you'll be able to come out to bar street for totally new dynamic experience. Now you can look around the post-apocalyptic world, try new kind of gameplay and face new kind of enemies with new tactics to fight against.
 
Animals are our friends. Unfortunately they are kind of friends, we can't share alcohol with, so they turned into blood-lusty beasts. Quick and deadly deers can't wait to impale someone with their antlers and birds bring the fear and pain from above. Hitchcock was totally right about the birds.
 
The new gear will help you to fight them. Drinking helmet will help you keep your drunk level within the normal limits and keep your hands free. So use both 'em to cover zombies into lead rain and two SMGs  will prove - it can be funny.

Have a good game.

notes.title: Drunk or Dead is a tequila-soaked VR shooter
notes.content: There’s a smorgasbord of VR games happening right now. Possibly, we are all trying to escape from this repugnant reality. Or maybe there’s just a bubble happening around VR what with all the Silicon Valley Nerds-in-Chiefs pushing their expensive headsets to the masses, encouraging lots of game makers to go and toy with the technology. Not a day goes by without the Steam early access lists filling up with more VRware, leaving me desensitised to the whole thing. Except when one of them is about downing shots in the midst of a zombie apocalypse and trying to shoot waves of the undead while your in-game vision blurs. They called it Drunk or Dead [Steam page] instead of “Dead Drunk” – the fools! … [visit site to read more]
